common.playDisclaimer: Everything here runs on play money. It never converts to real money, prizes, or anything of value. Market data is real; results show what would have happened.
common.dataFixture: Documented fallback values ({date}). Live data is unavailable right now
common.frameCaption: Practice mode. Play money, real market.
common.resetConfirm: This clears your play ledger and starts fresh. Nothing real is affected. Start over?

gate.title: diBoaS Sandbox
gate.subtitle: The product, in practice mode. Play money, real market. Nothing to lose while you learn the controls.
gate.error: That password did not open the door. Try again.
gate.notConfigured: The sandbox gate is not configured yet. Set SANDBOX_ACCESS_PASSWORD and restart.

firstRun.title: Your Working money has arrived.
firstRun.body: diBoaS is a side pocket: only your Working money comes here. The rest of your money stays where it is.
firstRun.workingBody: This is yours to practice with. Give it a goal, pick a strategy, and see what the real market does.

salary.title: First, what lands in your account each month?
salary.body: Your monthly take-home, after tax. It stays on this device and only helps the sandbox show your whole picture. Change it any time, or skip it.

home.title: Your money's jobs
home.subtitle: Every amount here has a job you gave it.
home.noGoalsBody: A goal gives working money somewhere to go. Name it, give it a target, and see the path before anything moves.
home.timeMachineNote: Practice is compressed time: advance the clock and replay what the market actually did.
home.workingBalanceNote: Yours to put to work. Pick a goal below.
home.awayBeat: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of real market passed while you were away.

goalNew.title: Create a goal
goalNew.subtitle: Define what you're working toward.
goalNew.fundLabel: Move this much working money into the goal now
goalNew.errorName: Give the goal a name. It is the reason the money moves.
goalNew.errorTarget: The target needs to be a positive amount.
goalNew.errorHorizon: Pick a horizon between 1 month and 40 years.
goalNew.errorFund: That is more than your working money right now.
goalNew.strategiesNote: This list is a filter, not advice: every strategy matching the horizon you set is here, in the same order for everyone. Nothing is pre-picked. You read, you choose.
goalNew.skipStrategy: Keep it as cash in the goal for now
goalNew.reviewPath: See the path before it moves
goalNew.recurringHint: Each month, this moves from your working money into the goal so it stays invested. Play money.
goalNew.noFundPath: Add a first amount on the previous step to put this goal to work. Or create it as cash for now.
goalNew.pathUnavailable: The live market isn't available right now, so the path can't be shown. Try again in a moment, or create this as cash for now.
goalNew.cashDropsRecurring: Keeping it as cash won't include the monthly amount. Choose the path below to set that up.

pathCard.title: The path, the cost, the risk.
pathCard.subtitle: Read this before anything moves.
pathCard.networkFee: Network fee (passed through at cost): about {amount}
pathCard.riskStable: Stable strategies aim to hold their value. Risks remain: the systems can have flaws, and the digital dollars used can lose their peg.
pathCard.riskGrowth: {percent}% of this strategy moves with market prices, so with real money it can fall as well as rise. Practice mode previews the returns these systems pay, not the price swings, so keep the real risk in mind.
pathCard.noPromise: No promises live here. The numbers are history and current rates, not the future.

manifest.title: Read before you approve
manifest.withdrawReassurance: You can take this out any time.
manifest.footer: Nothing moves until you approve. This is play money.

settlement.title: Confirming
settlement.note: This is how a real move would settle. In the sandbox it always confirms, and no real transaction happens.

goalDetail.cashInGoal: In the goal, not yet working: {amount}
goalDetail.earningsTitle: What this strategy would have returned
goalDetail.earningsLine: {amount} so far, replaying real market history
goalDetail.noPosition: This goal's money is sitting as cash. It can stay that way as long as you want.
goalDetail.milestoneTitle: You reached this goal, in practice.
goalDetail.milestoneBody: In real life, this is where you would decide what is next. Nothing here is real money.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Jeder Cent erfasst. Alle Salden gleichen sich aus.
history.empty: Nothing yet. The trail starts when your money gets its first job.
history.split: Assigned to jobs: {working}% working, {cushion}% cushion, {floor}% floor.
history.timeAdvanced: Time machine: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} forward
history.goalPaused: You paused {name}. The invested money keeps working.
history.positionReassigned: You moved a strategy from {from} to {to}.
history.goalTargetChanged: You changed the target for {name} from {old} to {new}.
history.recurringCleared: Turned off the monthly amount for {name}
history.feeDrag: Practice costs so far: {amount} in network and exit fees.

stableGrowth.name: Stable Growth
stableGrowth.tagline: A step past stable, with guardrails on

steadyProgress.name: Steady Progress
steadyProgress.tagline: Short-term goals, a little market in the mix

patientBuilder.name: Patient Builder
patientBuilder.tagline: Built for a long, patient horizon

balancedBuilder.name: Balanced Builder
balancedBuilder.tagline: Stable ground and market exposure, together

steadyCompounder.name: Steady Compounder
steadyCompounder.tagline: Let time do the heavy lifting

wealthAccelerator.name: Wealth Accelerator
wealthAccelerator.tagline: For those at ease with real ups and downs

fullHarvest.name: Full Harvest
fullHarvest.tagline: Low price swings, patient by design

mirror.caption: Roughly how a month like yours divides:
mirror.dignity: This month, your money is holding you up. That is its job right now, and that is okay.

emergencyFund.name: Emergency Fund
emergencyFund.desc: 6 months of essentials, about {target}. A calm first goal.

financialFreedom.name: Financial Freedom
financialFreedom.desc: Enough to replace your income, about {target}.
financialFreedom.projection: At a common ~10%-of-income guide (about {monthly}/mo) and an assumed {rate}%, roughly {years} years. A long game.

costAdjust.title: Your real costs
costAdjust.body: We used a rule of thumb for your fixed costs. Put in your real number to see your actual picture. If it's higher, less is free to put to work.
costAdjust.label: Your monthly fixed costs

recurring.explainer: Each month, this moves from your working money into this goal, so it stays invested.
recurring.note: Play money, and it runs only while your working money lasts. No fee on these in the sandbox.
recurring.pausedBody: Paused for now. Your working money ran out, so nothing new is going in. Add more or lower the amount.

projection.heading: The path from here
projection.rangeLine: At {amount} a month, an assumed {low} to {high} percent would reach {target} in about {minYears} to {maxYears} years.
projection.singleLine: At {amount} a month, an assumed {low} to {high} percent would reach {target} in about {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}.
projection.caveat: An assumption you can check, not a promise. Real returns move around and can be negative.
projection.paceWithin: This pace fits inside your {months}-month timeframe.
projection.paceEdge: This pace lands around your {months}-month timeframe.
projection.paceBeyond: This pace runs longer than your {months}-month timeframe.
projection.underYear: At {amount} a month, an assumed {low} to {high} percent would reach {target} within a year.

welcome.title: Your side pocket for building wealth.
welcome.body: diBoaS is the side pocket for your Working money. The rest of your money stays right where it is. Here you practice the real thing on play money, with the real market, so there is nothing to lose while you learn the controls.
welcome.point1: Only your Working money comes here. The rest stays put.
welcome.point2: Play money, real market. It never becomes real money.
welcome.point3: See the path, the cost, and the risk before anything moves.

geofence.title: In deiner Region nicht verfügbar
geofence.body: Die diBoaS-Übungsumgebung ist dort, wo du gerade bist, nicht verfügbar. Es liegt nicht an dir.
geofence.legal: Der Zugriff aus deiner Region ist aus Gründen der regulatorischen Compliance eingeschränkt.

authWelcome.tagline: Geld braucht einen Plan. Nicht nur ein Konto.
authWelcome.title: Für die Rücklage. Für das größere Vorhaben. Für den Plan, den du immer wieder verschiebst.
authWelcome.body: Entdecke Strategien, setze Ziele und entwickle dein Geldgespür.

consent.title: Bevor du startest
consent.intro: Wir bitten um deine Einwilligung, damit diBoaS so funktioniert, wie du es erwartest.
consent.requiredBody: Tippe auf Annehmen und fortfahren, um unseren <terms>Nutzungsbedingungen</terms> und der <privacy>Datenschutzerklärung</privacy> zuzustimmen und zu bestätigen, dass du 18 oder älter bist.
consent.optionalIntro: Diese Einstellungen helfen, diBoaS zu personalisieren. Du kannst sie jederzeit ändern.
consent.financialProfileBody: Teile etwas über deine Ziele und Erfahrung für passendere Vorschläge.
consent.analyticsBody: Hilf, diBoaS zu verbessern, indem du anonyme Nutzungsdaten teilst.
consent.marketingBody: Erhalte Produktneuigkeiten, Tipps und Angebote, die du wirklich nutzen kannst.
consent.optionalHint: Optional. Alles funktioniert so oder so.
consent.footer: Wir verkaufen deine Daten nie. Du behältst immer die Kontrolle. Mehr dazu in unserer <privacy>Datenschutzerklärung</privacy>.
consent.acceptNote: Wenn du fortfährst, stimmst du unseren <terms>Nutzungsbedingungen</terms> und unserer <privacy>Datenschutzerklärung</privacy> zu und bestätigst, dass du 18 Jahre oder älter bist.

claim.heading: Du erhältst gleich
claim.infoBody: Es hat keinen realen Wert und wird nie zu echtem Geld.

strategyDetail.caveat: Es kann in manchen Wochen sinken. Das ist normal, und Renditen sind nicht garantiert.
strategyDetail.costLine: Kostenlos zu starten. Eine kleine Gebühr von 0,39%, wenn du Geld abhebst. Dein Geld ist nie gebunden, jederzeit stoppen.
strategyDetail.protocolsNote: Läuft über vertrauenswürdige Lending-Protokolle. Renditen sind nicht garantiert.

strategyExample.name: Stetig wachsen
strategyExample.description: Ein stabiler, risikoärmerer Weg, mit der Zeit zu wachsen.
strategyExample.whatItIs: Ein ruhiger, risikoärmerer Weg, dein Geld mit der Zeit stetig wachsen zu lassen.
strategyExample.howItsDoing: Wächst sanft, mit kleinen Höhen und Tiefen unterwegs.

goalDual.pace: In diesem Tempo noch etwa {months} Monate.
goalDual.paceNote: Das ist ein Tempo, kein Versprechen.
goalDual.howLead: Wächst sanft in {strategy}, mit kleinen Höhen und Tiefen.
goalDual.nextLabel: Was du als Nächstes tun kannst

goalPause.title: Diesen Plan pausieren?
goalPause.body: Pausieren stoppt deinen Wochenplan und die Erinnerungen. Dein investiertes Geld arbeitet in der Strategie weiter.
goalPause.alsoStop: Auch aus der Strategie aussteigen? Du kannst sie ebenfalls stoppen (eine kleine Gebühr von 0,39% fällt an).

notifications.title: Benachrichtigungen
notifications.empty: Wenn es nichts Neues gibt, bleibt es hier ruhig.

profile.title: Profil
profile.subtitle: Verwalte, wie du bei diBoaS erscheinst.
profile.displayNameDesc: Das ist der Name, der in deinem Konto und in deiner Aktivität erscheint.
profile.handleDesc: Das ist deine öffentliche Identität für Zahlungen, Überweisungen und um gefunden zu werden.
profile.nicknameDesc: Das ist der Name, den deine Circles sehen. Du kannst ihn jederzeit ändern.

handle.subtitle: Wähle deinen einzigartigen @handle. Er wird Teil deines öffentlichen Links.
handle.rulePermanent: Dein @handle ist dauerhaft und kann nicht geändert werden.
handle.rulePrivate: Deine öffentliche Seite bleibt privat, bis du sie aktivierst.

practice.title: Übungsverlauf
practice.showPublic: Meilensteine auf deiner öffentlichen Seite zeigen
practice.empty: Deine Meilensteine erscheinen hier, während du übst. Nichts wird geteilt, außer du entscheidest dich dafür.

settings.title: Privatsphäre und Daten
settings.subtitle: Steuere deine Daten, Einstellungen und wie wir dein Erlebnis personalisieren.
settings.analyticsDesc: Hilf uns, diBoaS mit Nutzungsdaten zu verbessern
settings.exportSub: Lade eine Kopie deiner Daten herunter
settings.deleteSub: Lösche dein Konto und deine Daten dauerhaft
settings.footer: Mit der Nutzung von diBoaS stimmst du unseren <terms>Nutzungsbedingungen</terms> und der Datenschutzerklärung zu.

move.practiceNote: Du bist im Übungsmodus. Lerne mit echten Marktdaten und echten Tools.
move.addBody: Das funktioniert in der echten App. Im Übungsmodus kommt dein Guthaben aus deinem wöchentlichen Rhythmus.
move.earnBody: Dein Übungsguthaben kommt jede Woche, bereit für eine Aufgabe.
move.withdrawBody: Das funktioniert in der echten App. Im Übungsmodus bleibt das Geld im Sandbox.

comprehension.title: Comprehension micro-check
comprehension.subtitle: A quick check to make sure the key idea clicked before you move on.
comprehension.question: Can practice credits become real money?
comprehension.explainer: Practice credits let you explore and build confidence with no real money at stake. They do not convert to real money.
comprehension.correct: That's right. Practice credits stay play money, always.
comprehension.incorrect: Not quite. Practice credits never convert to real money.
comprehension.note: Sandbox keeps things safe so you can learn without pressure.

error.title: Something went sideways
error.body: This screen hit a snag. Your play money and progress are safe. Try again.
